title: Literal Stone Tools 💀
description: Changes stone tools to be visually quite... literal.
body:
# Stone Tools -> 💀 _Literal_ Stone Tools 💀

A Minecraft resourcepack to make your stone tools look like a caveman's cave-shop.

The sticks in the recipes are simply used to break the rocks :D

### Description;

Changes stone tools to be visually quite... _literal_.
![Textures](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ad16fa0b06d34a5c95836ba827394f4a6d09d1a3.png)

### Other Info;

Dependencies-

No hard mod requirements.

No soft mod requirements.


Version-

Revision 0 - Minecraft 26.1+

My packs are default released for latest version of Minecraft- if you want it ported to a newer or older version let me know. _(*Done at my discretion. Some things may be too difficult to port.)_
